<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Merriweather:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,700;0,900;1,300;1,400;1,700;1,900&family=Saira+Semi+Condensed:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    :root {
      --teal:   #0E7A7F;
      --teal-dark: #0B2B2C;
      --teal-light: rgba(14,122,127,.06);
      --teal-mid: rgba(14,122,127,.1);
      --ink:    #0B2B2C;
      --green:  #0E7A7F;
      --green-2:#0E7A7F;
      --cream:  #F3E9D9;
      --cream-2:#EDE8DE;
      --gold:   #F7C85A;
      --gold-2: #F0C14F;
      --warm:   #EDE8DE;
      --coral:  #E34B4B;
      --coral-dk: #C83A3A;
      --coral-light: rgba(227,75,75,.2);
      --green-soft: #4F8E72;
      --cyan:   #6DC7D1;
      --white:  #FFFFFF;
      --muted:  #6B6B6B;
      --line:   rgba(14,122,127,.12);
      --accent: #F7C85A;
      --accent-rgb: 247,200,90;
    }
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
    body {
      font-family: 'Saira Semi Condensed', sans-serif;
      background: var(--white); color: var(--ink);
      overflow-x: hidden; position: relative;
    }

    /* ── GEOMETRIC SHAPES ── */
    .geo-shapes { position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; overflow: hidden; }
    .geo { position: absolute; }
    .geo-shapes { position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; overflow: hidden; opacity: .15; }
    .geo-1 { width: 260px; height: 260px; background: var(--coral); top: -80px; left: -80px; border-radius: 50%; }
    .geo-2 { width: 180px; height: 300px; background: var(--teal); top: 0; right: -40px; border-radius: 0 0 0 40px; }
    .geo-3 { width: 200px; height: 200px; background: var(--gold); top: 60px; right: 140px; border-radius: 50%; opacity: .7; }
    .geo-4 { width: 160px; height: 160px; background: var(--cyan); top: 200px; right: -20px; border-radius: 50%; }
    .geo-5 { width: 140px; height: 140px; background: var(--green-soft); top: 45%; left: -60px; border-radius: 50%; opacity: .5; }
    .geo-6 { width: 100px; height: 100px; background: var(--gold); bottom: 30%; right: -30px; border-radius: 50%; opacity: .4; }
    .geo-7 { width: 220px; height: 120px; background: var(--coral); bottom: 10%; left: -40px; border-radius: 0 24px 24px 0; opacity: .6; }

    /* ── NAV ── */
    nav {
      position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 100;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 14px 48px;
      background: rgba(247,200,90,.95); backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      transition: padding .4s;
    }
    nav.scrolled {
      padding: 12px 48px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.06);
    }
    .nav-logo {
      font-family: 'Merriweather', serif; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -.06em; color: var(--ink); line-height: 1;
      text-decoration: none; display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px;
    }
    .nav-logo sup { font-size: 22px; color: var(--gold); vertical-align: super; letter-spacing: 0; }
    .nav-links { display: flex; gap: 36px; align-items: center; }
    .nav-links a {
      font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(11,43,44,.65);
      text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: .02em; transition: color .2s;
    }
    .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--ink); }
    .nav-cta {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.45); color: var(--ink);
      border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.18);
      border-radius: 999px; padding: 10px 20px;
      font-size: 13px; font-weight: 750; cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform .15s, background .15s;
    }
    .nav-cta:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); background: rgba(255,255,255,.7); }
    .nav-hamburger { display: none; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; cursor: pointer; }
    .nav-hamburger span { display: block; width: 24px; height: 2px; background: var(--ink); border-radius: 1px; }

    /* ── MOBILE MENU ── */
    .mobile-menu {
      position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 98;
      background: rgba(247,200,90,.97); backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      gap: 32px; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity .3s;
    }
    .mobile-menu.open { opacity: 1; pointer-events: all; }
    .mobile-menu a {
      font-family: 'Merriweather', serif; font-size: 36px; font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -.04em; color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; transition: color .2s;
    }
    .mobile-menu a:hover { color: var(--teal); }

    /* ── HERO ── */
    .hero {
      min-height: 100svh; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: flex-end; padding: 0 48px 56px;
      position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .hero-layout { display: contents; }
    .hero-right { display: none; }
    .hero-bg {
      position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0;
      background: url('https://mane.com.vc/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/Imagem-do-WhatsApp.jpg') center center/cover no-repeat;
    }
    .hero-bg::after {
      content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(14,122,127,.55) 0%, rgba(11,43,44,.7) 50%, rgba(11,43,44,.92) 100%);
    }
    .hero-deco {
      position: absolute; top: 16%; right: -2%;
      font-family: 'Merriweather', serif; font-size: clamp(120px, 18vw, 260px);
      font-weight: 900; font-style: italic;
      color: transparent; -webkit-text-stroke: 1px rgba(243,233,217,.08);
      line-height: .85; pointer-events: none; user-select: none; z-index: 1; letter-spacing: -.06em;
    }
    .hero-content { position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: 1240px; }

    /* Trust badges row */
    .hero-trust {
      display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 20px;
      opacity: 0; animation: fadeUp .6s .05s both;
    }
    .trust-badge {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
      background: rgba(243,233,217,.07); border: 1px solid rgba(243,233,217,.14);
      border-radius: 999px; padding: 7px 14px;
      font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .05em;
      text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(243,233,217,.85);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    }
    .trust-badge.gold { background: rgba(247,200,90,.15); border-color: rgba(247,200,90,.3); color: var(--gold); }
    .trust-badge.green { background: rgba(79,142,114,.14); border-color: rgba(79,142,114,.28); color: #7de8d0; }

    .hero-eyebrow {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      opacity: 0; animation: fadeUp .7s .15s both;
    }
    .eyebrow-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--gold); animation: pulse 2.4s infinite; }
    @keyframes pulse {
      0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(247,200,90,.5); }
      50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px rgba(247,200,90,0); }
    }
    .eyebrow-text { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .13em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold); }

    .hero-headline {
      font-family: 'Merriweather', serif;
      font-size: clamp(52px, 8.5vw, 128px);
      font-weight: 900; line-height: .9; letter-spacing: -.04em; color: var(--cream);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      opacity: 0; animation: fadeUp .8s .25s both;
    }
    .hero-headline .highlight { position: relative; display: inline; }
    .hero-headline .highlight::after { display: none; }
    .hero-headline .line-2 { display: block; font-style: italic; color: var(--cream); transition: color .5s; }

    .hero-sub {
      font-size: clamp(16px, 2vw, 21px); font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.55;
      color: rgba(243,233,217,.78); max-width: 52ch;
      margin-bottom: 36px; margin-top: 18px;
      opacity: 0; animation: fadeUp .8s .38s both;
      text-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.28);
    }
    .hero-sub strong { color: #fff; font-weight: 700; text-shadow: 0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.32); }

    .occasion-strip {
      display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 36px;
      opacity: 0; animation: fadeUp .8s .48s both;
    }
    .oc-pill {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
      background: rgba(243,233,217,.07); border: 1px solid rgba(243,233,217,.13);
      border-radius: 999px; padding: 10px 18px;
      font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(243,233,217,.8);
      cursor: pointer; transition: all .25s; backdrop-filter: blur(8px); white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .oc-pill:hover { background: rgba(247,200,90,.15); border-color: rgba(247,200,90,.4); color: var(--cream); transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .oc-pill.active { background: rgba(247,200,90,.22); border-color: rgba(247,200,90,.6); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(247,200,90,.3); }
    .oc-pill-emoji { font-size: 16px; }

    .hero-cta-row {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; flex-wrap: wrap;
      opacity: 0; animation: fadeUp .8s .58s both;
    }
    .btn-main {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
      background: var(--gold); color: var(--ink); border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 16px 32px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .01em;
      cursor: pointer; border: none; transition: transform .18s, box-shadow .18s; text-decoration: none;
    }
    .btn-main:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 36px rgba(247,200,90,.4); }
    .btn-main svg { transition: transform .2s; }
    .btn-main:hover svg { transform: translateX(3px); }
    .btn-ghost-link {
      font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(243,233,217,.75);
      text-decoration: none; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; transition: color .2s;
    }
    .btn-ghost-link:hover { color: var(--cream); }

    .hero-proof {
      position: absolute; bottom: 56px; right: 48px; z-index: 2;
      display: flex; gap: 32px; opacity: 0; animation: fadeUp .8s .7s both;
    }
    .proof-item { text-align: right; }
    .proof-num { font-family: 'Merriweather', serif; font-size: 32px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.04em; color: var(--cream); line-height: 1; }
    .proof-label { font-size: 11px; color: rgba(243,233,217,.55); letter-spacing: .05em; margin-top: 2px; }

    .scroll-indicator {
      position: absolute; bottom: 32px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
      opacity: 0; animation: fadeUp .6s 1.1s both; z-index: 2;
    }
    .scroll-indicator span { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(243,233,217,.35); }
    .scroll-line { width: 1px; height: 36px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(243,233,217,.35), transparent); animation: scrollLine 1.6s .5s infinite; }
    @keyframes scrollLine {
      0% { transform: scaleY(0); transform-origin: top; }
      50% { transform: scaleY(1); transform-origin: top; }
      51% { transform: scaleY(1); transform-origin: bottom; }
      100% { transform: scaleY(0); transform-origin: bottom; }
    }

    /* ══ MARQUEE TICKER ══ */
    .ticker {
      background: var(--gold); overflow: hidden;
      padding: 14px 0; position: relative; z-index: 10;
    }
    .ticker-track {
      display: flex; gap: 0;
      animation: tickerScroll 28s linear infinite;
      width: max-content;
    }
    .ticker-track:hover { animation-play-state: paused; }
    @keyframes tickerScroll {
      0% { transform: translateX(0); }
      100% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }
    @keyframes restScroll {
      0% { transform: translateX(0); }
      100% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }
    .ticker-item {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
      padding: 0 32px; white-space: nowrap;
      font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em;
      text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink);
    }
    .ticker-sep { color: rgba(11,43,44,.3); font-size: 16px; }

    /* ══ BIG CLAIM ══ */
    .claim-section {
      background: var(--white);
      padding: 96px 48px 80px;
      position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .claim-section::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute; top: -100px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 900px; height: 500px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(14,122,127,.06), transparent 65%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .claim-inner { max-width: 1240px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .claim-grid {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 80px; align-items: center;
    }
    .claim-text {}
    .claim-eyebrow {
      font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .13em; text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--teal); margin-bottom: 18px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
    }
    .claim-eyebrow::before { content: ''; width: 28px; height: 1px; background: var(--teal); opacity: .6; }
    .claim-title {
      font-family: 'Merriweather', serif;
      font-size: clamp(38px, 5.5vw, 72px); font-weight: 900;
      line-height: .9; letter-spacing: -.05em; color: var(--ink);
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .claim-title em { font-style: italic; color: var(--teal); }
    .claim-body {
      font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.7; color: rgba(11,43,44,.6);
      font-weight: 300; max-width: 50ch; margin-bottom: 32px;
    }
    .claim-badges { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .cb {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
      border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 16px;
      font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .04em;
    }
    .cb.gold { background: rgba(247,200,90,.15); border: 1px solid rgba(247,200,90,.3); color: var(--gold-2); }
    .cb.gold { background: rgba(247,200,90,.15); border: 1px solid rgba(247,200,90,.3); color: var(--gold-2); }
    .cb.green { background: rgba(14,122,127,.08); border: 1px solid rgba(14,122,127,.18); color: var(--green); }

    /* Stats grid */
    .stats-grid {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 14px;
    }
    .stat-card {
      background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(14,122,127,.10);
      border-radius: 20px; padding: 24px 22px;
      transition: background .25s, border-color .25s, transform .25s;
    }
    .stat-card:hover { background: #fff; border-color: rgba(227,75,75,.3); transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(14,122,127,.08); }
    .stat-num {
      font-family: 'Merriweather', serif; font-size: 52px; font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -.06em; line-height: 1; color: var(--green);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .stat-num span { color: var(--gold); font-size: 38px; }
    .stat-label { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(11,43,44,.55); line-height: 1.5; font-weight: 300; }
    .stat-card.featured {
      background: var(--green); border-color: transparent;
      grid-column: span 2;
    }
    .stat-card.featured .stat-num { font-size: 38px; color: var(--cream); }
    .stat-card.featured .stat-label { color: rgba(243,233,217,.8); }

    /* ══ FOOD VISUAL STRIP ══ */
    .food-strip {
      background: var(--warm); padding: 72px 48px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .food-strip-inner { max-width: 1240px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .food-strip-header {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 48px; align-items: end; margin-bottom: 48px;
    }
    .food-strip-title {
      font-family: 'Merriweather', serif; font-size: clamp(32px, 4vw, 54px);
      font-weight: 900; line-height: .92; letter-spacing: -.05em; color: var(--ink);
    }
    .food-strip-title em { font-style: italic; color: var(--teal); }
    .food-strip-body { font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.7; color: rgba(14,31,24,.6); font-weight: 300; }
    .food-strip-body strong { color: var(--ink); }

    .food-cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 14px; }
    .food-card {
      border-radius: 20px; overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid rgba(14,31,24,.08);
      background: #fff;
      transition: transform .25s, box-shadow .25s;
      cursor: default;
    }
    .food-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: 0 20px 48px rgba(14,31,24,.12); }
    .food-img {
      height: 220px; position: relative; overflow: hidden;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    }
    .food-card-body { padding: 16px; }
    .food-card-title { font-family: 'Merriweather', serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.02em; color: var(--ink); margin-bottom: 4px; }
    .food-card-chef { font-size: 11px; color: var(--green); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .04em; }

    /* ══ PROBLEM / WHY ══ */
    .problem-section { background: var(--warm); padding: 96px 48px; }
    .problem-inner { max-width: 1240px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .problem-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 80px; align-items: center; }
    .problem-quote {
      font-family: 'Merriweather', serif;
      font-size: clamp(26px, 3.5vw, 44px); font-weight: 400; font-style: italic;
      line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -.02em; color: var(--ink);
    }
    .problem-quote strong { font-weight: 700; font-style: normal; display: block; font-style: italic; color: var(--teal); }
    .problem-points { display: grid; gap: 22px; }
    .problem-point { display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: flex-start; }
    .pp-icon { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 14px; flex-shrink: 0; background: rgba(14,122,127,.08); display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 20px; }
    .pp-text strong { display: block; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink); margin-bottom: 4px; }
    .pp-text p { font-size: 14px; color: rgba(11,43,44,.6); line-height: 1.55; font-weight: 300; }

    /* ══ OCCASIONS ══ */
    .occasions-section { background: var(--green); padding: 96px 48px; }
    .occasions-inner { max-width: 1240px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .occasions-header { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 60px; align-items: end; margin-bottom: 52px; }
    .s-eyebrow { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .13em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold); margin-bottom: 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; opacity: .85; }
    .s-eyebrow::before { content: ''; width: 28px; height: 1px; background: var(--coral); opacity: .6; }
    .s-title { font-family: 'Merriweather', serif; font-size: clamp(32px, 4.5vw, 62px); font-weight: 700; line-height: .95; letter-spacing: -.04em; color: var(--cream); margin-bottom: 20px; }
    .s-title em { font-style: italic; color: var(--cream); }
    .s-body { font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.7; color: rgba(243,233,217,.78); font-weight: 300; max-width: 58ch; }

    .occasions-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 14px; }
    .oc-card {
      background: rgba(243,233,217,.04); border: 1px solid rgba(243,233,217,.08);
      border-radius: 22px; padding: 26px 22px; cursor: pointer;
      transition: all .3s; position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .oc-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 22px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(227,75,75,.15), transparent); opacity: 0; transition: opacity .3s; }
    .oc-card:hover::before { opacity: 1; }
    .oc-card:hover { border-color: rgba(227,75,75,.35); background: rgba(227,75,75,.08); transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 20px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.25); }
    .oc-card-emoji { font-size: 30px; margin-bottom: 14px; display: block; }
    .oc-card h4 { font-family: 'Merriweather', serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.02em; color: var(--cream); margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.25; }
    .oc-card p { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(243,233,217,.78); line-height: 1.6; font-weight: 300; }
    .oc-card-arrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--gold); margin-top: 14px; opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-6px); transition: opacity .25s, transform .25s; }
    .oc-card:hover .oc-card-arrow { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }
    .oc-card-bg {
      position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 22px;
      background-size: cover; background-position: center;
      opacity: .35; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0;
    }
    .oc-card[data-bg] > *:not(.oc-card-bg) { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

    /* ══ CELEBRATE SPLIT ══ */
    .celebrate-section { background: var(--white); padding: 72px 48px; }
    .celebrate-inner { max-width: 1240px; margin: 0 auto; }

    .celebrate-block {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 0;
      border-radius: 28px; overflow: hidden; margin-bottom: 20px;
      min-height: 400px;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(14,122,127,.1);
    }

    .cel-visual {
      position: relative; overflow: hidden;
      display: flex; align-items: flex-end;
      padding: 32px 36px;
    }
    .cel-visual-corp {
      background: var(--green);
    }
    .cel-visual-corp::before {
      content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0;
      background: url('https://mane.com.vc/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/Reserva-scaled.jpg') center/cover no-repeat;
      opacity: .4; pointer-events: none;
    }
    .cel-visual-bday {
      background: var(--green);
    }
    .cel-visual-bday::before {
      content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0;
      background: url('https://mane.com.vc/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/Mask-group-7-2.png') center/cover no-repeat;

<script>
  // ── NAV scroll ──
  const nav = document.getElementById('mainNav');
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 60));

  // ── Mobile menu ──
  function toggleMenu() { document.getElementById('mobileMenu').classList.toggle('open'); }

  // ── Occasion pill selection ──
  const accentLine = document.getElementById('heroAccentLine');
  const heroCta = document.getElementById('heroCta');

  function selectOccasion(pill) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.oc-pill').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
    pill.classList.add('active');
    const occasion = pill.dataset.occasion;
    const color = pill.dataset.color;
    accentLine.style.opacity = '0';
    setTimeout(() => {
      accentLine.textContent = occasion;
      accentLine.style.transition = 'opacity .3s';
      accentLine.style.opacity = '1';
    }, 150);
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--accent-rgb', color);
    heroCta.style.background = `rgb(${color})`;
  }

  // ── Scroll reveal ──
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
    entries.forEach(e => { if (e.isIntersecting) e.target.classList.add('in'); });
  }, { threshold: 0.10 });
  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
</script>
